# google_kms_key_ring

Get ephemeral access to a Cloud Key Management Service KeyRing.


A `KeyRing` is a toplevel logical grouping of `CryptoKeys`.

~> **Note:** KeyRings cannot be deleted from Google Cloud Platform.
Destroying a Terraform-managed KeyRing will remove it from state but
*will not delete the resource from the project.*


For more information see the [API](https://cloud.google.com/kms/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.keyRings).

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:
* `name` -
  (Required)
  The resource name for the KeyRing.

* `location` -
  (Required)
  The location for the KeyRing.
  A full list of valid locations can be found by running `gcloud kms locations list`.


* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project. If not provided, the provider project is used.
